# Terraform on Azure — Sample Chapters
> 31 production lessons in Terraform on Azure: permissions, private networking, monitoring, and cost — each starting from a real incident, each verified by plan. Free sample chapters with runnable examples.

Terraform on Azure — free sample chapters (Docsify reader + raw markdown). Runnable examples on GitHub; full book on Leanpub.
